title: 152쪽 · Villian (BTN)
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Hero bets $70. Villain calls. Hero should bet and continue to extract value from 10-x, 9-9-5. 3-3, and clubs. Villain will always assume that Hero is barreling with clus and overcards.
Hero checks. Villain bets $140. Hero folds.
\y. Hero should check-fold this river as a default.
